name: io.github.verkyyi/tally
title: Tally
description: Company and open-source numbers (valuation, revenue, prices, stars) with history and sources.

tools.name: search_numbers
tools.description: Find numbers in the Tally record by words, for example 'anthropic valuation', 'openai revenue', 'langchain stars', 'cursor plan price'. Returns each match with its id, current value and page, and any company whose name matches.

query.description: A company or project name, optionally with what to measure.

tools.name: get_number
tools.description: One number's current value with its date, the page it was read from, when it last changed and by how much, and where its history and chart are. Cite the 'page' address when you use the value.

page.description: Or the number's page address on tallycatalog.com.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: The dated past values of one number, oldest first, each with the page it was read from. Use it for trends, growth rates and 'what was it on a given date'.

page.description: Or the number's page address on tallycatalog.com.

since.description: Only values on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: How many of the latest points to return (default 200, at most 1000).

tools.name: get_value_on
tools.description: What a number was on a given past day, from the record: the last value on or before that day, the date it was recorded, what set it when known (for example a funding round), its source, and when it next changed. Nothing is interpolated. Use it for questions like 'what was X's valuation in March 2025'.

page.description: Or the number's page address on tallycatalog.com.

date.description: The day to look up, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Every number Tally keeps about one company, project, sector or investor, each with its current value and id.

name.description: The name, for example 'Anthropic', 'Stripe', 'LangChain', or a stock ticker.

tools.name: what_moved_this_week
tools.description: The numbers whose value changed in the last seven days: funding rounds, valuations and prices first, then the biggest moves.
